Zelenskyy addresses UN, seeks end to Russia-Ukraine war

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is scheduled to address the UN General Assembly on Wednesday, aiming to convey the urgency of Ukraine's situation to world leaders. He is also seeking to shape renewed diplomatic efforts for an end to the Russia-Ukraine war, which has been ongoing for over four and a half years. Zelenskyy met with US President Donald Trump on Tuesday to discuss a potential bilateral ceasefire on energy-related targets. The conflict has disrupted global wheat supplies, forcing major buyers to seek alternative sources and raising concerns about food inflation.
